quotes.title: HD 146389
quotes.card: HD 146389, also known as WASP-38 and named Irena, is a star with a yellow-white hue in the northern constellation of Hercules.
quotes.introduction: It is invisible to the naked eye with an apparent visual magnitude of 9.4 The star is located at a distance of approximately 445 light-years from the Sun based on parallax, but is drifting closer with a radial velocity of −9 km/s.
